slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: the ideas: id, title, excerpt, votes (the person's own included), voted (true or false), comments (a count), posted (a date)

slots.name: top_word
slots.about: the sort button while ranked by votes

slots.name: new_word
slots.about: the sort button while ranked by date

slots.name: sort_label
slots.about: spoken before the sort on its button

slots.name: search_label
slots.about: the search field's label and placeholder

slots.name: vote_word
slots.about: spoken before the title on the vote button when not voted

slots.name: unvote_word
slots.about: spoken before the title on the vote button when voted

slots.name: no_match_text
slots.about: what shows when the search matches nothing

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is no idea yet

empty.shows: empty; the sort and search row hides

fallback.shows: no_match_text when the search finds nothing

attention.shows: the own vote as a check icon (not colour alone) and the label says unvote

labels.vote: vote_word or unvote_word, the title and the count

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Top sorts by votes, New by date, both with the lower id first on ties. Search matches the title, case does not matter. The add button and the sheet header are left out.
